data.title: Multiple Account Access from Single Source
data.description: Detects multiple distinct banking accounts being accessed from a single device or IP address within a short timeframe. This pattern is consistent with an attacker using stolen credentials from an infostealer dump to sequentially access compromised accounts for reconnaissance or initial positioning before fraudulent transactions.

queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Multiple Account Access from Single Source")`
`comment("Aggregation that cannot be expressed in Sigma")`
`comment("Original condition: selection | count(distinct account_id) by source_ip > 5 or selection | count(distinct account_id) by device_fingerprint > 3")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:auth_logs event_type="login_success"
| stats dc(account_id) as unique_account_id by source_ip
| where unique_account_id > 5
| stats dc(account_id) as unique_account_id by device_fingerprint
| where unique_account_id > 3

falsepositives: Shared corporate NAT gateways where multiple employees access accounts from same public IP
Household devices shared among family members with separate accounts
